'''Günter Asser''' (26 February 1926, [[Berlin]] – 23 March 2015) was a professor emeritus of [[logic]] and [[mathematics]] at the [[University of Greifswald]].<ref>[http://stubber.math-inf.uni-greifswald.de/personen/emeriti.html Emeriti] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304135202/http://stubber.math-inf.uni-greifswald.de/personen/emeriti.html |date=4 March 2016 }}, Ernst-Moritz-Arndt-Universität Greifswald, Mathematisch-Naturwissenschaftliche Fakultät, Institut für Mathematik und Informatik, retrieved 2014-08-03.</ref> He published numerous volumes on [[philosopher]]s and [[mathematician]]s. His own research was in [[computability theory]].

In 1954, with his doctoral advisor Karl Schröter, he co-founded the journal ''Zeitschrift für Mathematische Logik und Grundlagen der Mathematik'', which later became ''Mathematical Logic Quarterly''.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://journalseek.net/cgi-bin/journalseek/journalsearch.cgi?field=issn&query=0942-5616 |title=MLQ website |access-date=1 June 2010 |archive-date=3 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303233537/http://journalseek.net/cgi-bin/journalseek/journalsearch.cgi?field=issn&query=0942-5616 |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 1977, Günter Asser became member of the [[German Academy of Sciences at Berlin]].
